current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been this awful low mood for a long time, and I just can’t seem to enjoy anything. I’m exhausted all the time too. It’s been going on for about three years, and even with different treatments it hasn’t lifted much… I keep thinking maybe I’d be better off dead, which is horrible to say out loud.
current_concerns.goals: Honestly, I just want something that actually works. I’m so tired of feeling like a lost cause, and I want to stop this from going on and on.
